resolved_intents.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is displayed
Verify tell your experience textbox is found
Get entered tell your experience value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should retrieve the entered text from the 'tell your experience' textbox using get_entered_text() and verify that the text length does not exceed the expected maximum character limit. It should also verify the character count display matches the actual text length. The method should raise an assertion error if the text is not properly truncated at the maximum length boundary. Parameters: expected_max_length - the maximum number of characters allowed in the textbox (typically 1000 or similar). Returns: Boolean True if text is properly truncated, raises AssertionError otherwise.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback')
Call existing get_entered_text() method to retrieve the current text value from the feedback textbox
Calculate the actual character count of the retrieved text using len() function
Assert that the actual character count does not exceed expected_max_length parameter
Wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback_char_count')
Get the character count display text using self.driver.get_attribute('edit_feedback_char_count', 'Name')
Parse the character count display text to extract the current count value (format expected: 'X/Y' where X is current count)
Assert that the displayed character count matches the actual text length calculated earlier
Assert that the displayed maximum character count matches the expected_max_length parameter
Return True if all assertions pass, otherwise raise AssertionError with descriptive message indicating which validation failed
